actual: After BUG-153 was merged and local main synced to 1d917189, live API validation on http://127.0.0.1:8001 still returned the old Research Assistant routing behavior until backend restart. The assistant and operator UI do not expose a first-class runtime code/version visibility card or endpoint that compares the running backend code commit with local/origin main, so agents can misreport whether merged fixes are active. Add Research Assistant-scoped runtime code visibility to health/chat/UI so future validation can clearly distinguish code merged from runtime activated without restarting services automatically.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
